reuse.why: The change reuses recurrence conversion and weekend adjustment helpers, but the range handler independently implements the daily skip policy.

duplication.why: Daily occurrence filtering is repeated between getNextDate and getDatesInRange, including a separate reconstruction of the blocked-day predicate.

placement.why: Holiday matching belongs in shared schedules, but the server handler also owns scheduling policy that should reside alongside it.

scope.why: The edits are focused on schedule occurrence handling, holiday configuration, the requested handler, and relevant tests.

maintainability.why: Maintainers must coordinate multiple implementations of daily skipping, while fixed occurrence limits and range padding embed unexplained policy assumptions.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getDatesInRange in server/schedules/app.ts reconstructs shared scheduling decisions through its own daily-frequency check and weekend-or-holiday predicate.

disguised_duplication.where: The range handler expresses the shared daily blocked-occurrence filtering as a map-to-null pipeline, using d.isWeekend plus isScheduleHoliday instead of isBlockedScheduleDay.

abstraction_drift.where: WeekendRule gains holidays; getNextDate adds daily-specific branches for iteration start, take count, forward filtering, and reverse fallback filtering; getDatesInRange independently implements daily skipping, while upcoming dates and budget templates retain adjustment-only paths.
